contentPattern.structure: Rows (all optional): a text row with the field label/placeholder; a link to the results page (the form submits there with ?q=); a link to a .json query index (default /query-index.json). Without a results-page link, or on the results page itself, matching articles render inline

usage: Expat resource-center landing, category and search results pages.
reuseGuidance: Place on the results page with no results link (or a link to itself) to show inline results; elsewhere link to the results page.
